rationale.consistency: Follows package conventions and cleanly replaces the broken reverse approach, though duplicates prefix logic in reverse.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails on multi-byte UTF-8 due to strings.EqualFold yielding true for any invalid bytes, and makes regular characters case-insensitive.
rationale.scope: Addresses the percent-encoding requirements and removes dead code, but alters case-sensitivity semantics contrary to instructions.
rationale.readability: Clear loop structure, well-named variables, and helpful comments explaining the backward traversal logic.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles out-of-bounds access and gracefully aborts on invalid URL escapes without panicking.
rationale.maintainability: The custom backwards byte-by-byte state machine is inherently fragile and harder to maintain than a forward-parsing approach.
